        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /csi

        resources:

            cpu: 100m
            memory: 300Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 20Mi
      - name: liveness-probe
        image: mcr.microsoft.com/oss/kubernetes-csi/livenessprobe:v2.3.0
        args:
        - --csi-address=/csi/csi.sock
        - --probe-timeout=3s
        - --health-port=29632
        volumeMounts:
        - name: socket-dir
          mountPath: /csi
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 100Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 20Mi
      - name: blob

        - --v=5
